0x000056.en:
The Inspectors, aliens who militarily intervened in the Earth Sphere...
Neue DC, a military org that revolted against the Earth Federation government...
The Shadow-Mirror, special forces from a parallel world who colluded with them from the shadows...
And the mysterious bio-weapon Einst series.

0x000187.en:
These main forces were wiped out through the efforts of the Earth Federation
Army's battleships Hagane, Hiryu Kai, and Kurogane.

0x00021A.en:
The chain of conflicts later called the "Inspector Incident" came to a close,
and the Earth Sphere was about to regain its peace.

0x0002B9.en:
Learning from repeated battles with extraterrestrial life, the
Earth Federation government chose to further strengthen the "Aegis Plan,"
aimed at reorganizing the Federation Army and boosting its armaments.

0x000398.en:
As part of this, makers were asked to develop a new mass-production main
unit to succeed the Mass-Prod Huckebein Mk-II, and trials were to
be held.

0x000462.en: But people had not yet realized.

0x000497.en:
That invaders from another world had not ceased...
And that they had been acting since the end of the Inspector Incident.

0x000533.en: A new war-bell was now about to be sounded.

0x0005A1.en:
The Earth Federation Army's 3rd Special Operations PT unit "Kurai Wolves"
took charge of guarding the Earth Cradle. By order of Dr. Mitarl Zapad, head
of the Zentr Project - a plan to develop mass-produced mobile weapons
focused on autonomous action and maintenance-free operation - Captain
Albero, with subordinate Hugo and his son Foglia, captures Einst Regisseur.

0x0007B5.en:
At the request of Dr. Eric Wong of the same project, the Kurai Wolves head
to White Star to recover a spatial-transfer device mounted on the Shadow-
Mirror's special unit Zweizergain. Infiltrating the core, Hugo and the others
recover the wreckage of the unit they find there and escape White Star...

0x0009AA.en:
Kouta Azuma, a high-school student living in Asakusa, is caught up in an
attack by a mysterious enemy that suddenly appears and is driven into a
corner. To protect the town and his sister Shouko, Kouta accepts Roar, a
warrior who appeared in his dream, and transforms into Fighter Roar.
Meanwhile, his grandfather Kisaburo launches the Compatible Kaiser he was
entrusted with by Roar to save Kouta...

0x000BA7.en:
At the same time, two Unknowns calling themselves "Shura" appear. They
begin their attack on Kouta. With the help of Kai and the others who launch,
Kouta succeeds in driving the enemy out of Asakusa. His grandfather
Kisaburo tells him that Kouta was chosen by Roar, a warrior from another
world, to protect the world.

0x000D6D.en:
During the Earth Federation Army's ceremony unveiling a new main unit at
Harumi, the Federation's next main unit Barrelor suddenly goes berserk. In
the chaos, Shouko, who was at the ceremony hall, is abducted by the Shura
Folka, and Kusuha and Lamia are carried off by Barrelor.

0x000EEF.en:
The "ODE System" uses abducted humans as the living cores of mobile
weapons, controlling the system with a Master Core. To halt this system,
developed by Dr. Jurgen, the Hagane and Hiryu Kai attempt to storm his
base "Hell Gate." The group rescues Kusuha and the others carried by
Barrelor and advances into the interior of Hell Gate.

0x0010E6.en:
Blocking the path of the Hagane and Hiryu Kai as they storm into Hell Gate
was Lamia, made into Barrelor's living core. Just when it seemed her rescue
had succeeded, Lamia falls by the hand of Dr. Jurgen, who had lost his ego
to the ODE System. After a fierce battle, the group destroys the Master Core.
But then a new mysterious enemy appears...

0x00130B.en:
With the hour of the Federation fleet's nuclear strike on Hell Gate drawing
near, the Hagane and Hiryu Kai are forced to withdraw from Hell Gate...

0x001407.en:
The Shura make their stronghold of the giant structure "Sordian" that
appeared near Hell Gate. The matchless Shura generals and the Shura King
Alkaid who commands them begin attacks on Earth's bases to seize the
Earth Sphere. Against this, the Earth Federation Army could take no
effective measures against the Sordian, protected by a barrier.

0x0015EA.en:
The Earth Sphere is thrown into chaos by the Shura's assault. Former Shadow-
Mirror member Axel Almer is woken by a voice he recognizes. He and his
Soulgain had been transferred to the Zentr Project's laboratory. Left all
alone, questioning the meaning of living, Axel hears a girl's voice speaking
directly into his mind.

0x0017D1.en:
As a result of Mitarl's experiments, the Einst Regisseur had transformed into
the Jetzt Regisseur. The uncontrollable Jetzt goes berserk, and the Kurai
Wolves, ordered to capture it again, are driven into a corner. Axel boards
the Soulgain and throws himself into the flames of war once more...

0x00198C.en:
Albero resolves to annihilate the Jetzt. With the aid of Shu's Granzon, which
appears by chance, the Jetzt is driven off. Axel, having resolved to witness
where a world full of chaos and strife will end up, pursues the fled Jetzt
together with Alfimi.

0x001B18.en:
Through his contact with Shouko, Folka comes to doubt the Shura way that
"strength is everything." With the handover of Shouko to Duminuss at hand,
he resolves to cast away the name of Shura. Against the traitor Folka, who
fled with Shouko, the strategist Mizar sends Folka's fellow disciple
Fernando...

0x001CEB.en:
Folka protects Shouko and faces off against Fernando, but the opening is
seized and Shouko is carried off again. Worn out from the battle, Folka is
taken aboard the Kurogane. Meeting Shouko's brother Kouta and their
grandfather Kisaburo, he sets his heart on rescuing Shouko.

0x001E98.en:
As if reacting to the Unknown that appeared at the Tesla Leicht Institute,
the sleeping RyuOhKi and KoOhKi awaken. Dr. Eri Anzai of the LTR mechanism
surmises that the "Yokijin" - enemies of the "Chokijin" made in ancient
China, destroyed in an ancient battle - may have revived. It foretold a new
upheaval.

0x00206F.en:
Duminuss has at last obtained one of the "keys," Shouko. Before Kouta and
the others, who fight to save Shouko, a mysterious black unit appears. That
unit resonates with the Compatible Kaiser and emits light...

0x0021C3.en:
Kouta is stunned to learn that the pilot of the mysterious black unit, the
G Thundergate, is his sister Shouko. It was Axel and Alfimi who saved
Raul and the others in their plight. Against Kyosuke and the others who
rush to the rescue, Lamia, repaired by Duminuss, is sent...

0x00237B.en:
With Axel's help, Kyosuke and the others succeed in retaking Lamia.
Meanwhile, Roar, having learned that the G Thundergate is under
Duminuss's command, feared an encounter with his old foe Dark Brain.

0x0024BE.en:
Folka faces off against his sworn brother and the strongest Shura general,
Altis of the Flash. There the G Thundergate of Shouko, now Fighter Emmy,
appears. In the midst of battle, Kouta keeps trying to persuade Shouko...

0x00261E.en:
Shouko is freed from Duminuss's mind control, and the Compatible Kaiser
and G Thundergate combine into the G Compatible Kaiser. Having at last
gotten Shouko back, Kouta drives off Tis and the others under Duminuss.

0x00277C.en:
To annihilate the Jetzt Regisseur that fled the laboratory, the Kurai Wolves
launch their attack. But the Jetzt Regisseur, activated by the RBE round
entrusted by Mitarl, kills Foglia as he shields his father Albero. Hugo is
also critically wounded, and the Kurai Wolves are wiped out.

0x00293C.en:
Using the captured Shura transfer device "Daga," the Sordian assault
plan "Operation Overgate" began. Hagane and Hiryu Kai succeeded in
transferring inside Sordian. In his battle with Fernando, Folka made
Yaldabaoth undergo deification.

0x002AC6.en:
Hagane and Hiryu Kai press deep into Sordian. The Shura generals and
Shura King Alkaid try to stop them. Both sides clash with fate at
stake, and the defeated Shura King entrusts Shura's future to Folka.

0x002C0A.en:
Duminuss tries to destroy Hagane and Hiryu Kai, who have driven off
the Shura and broken into Sordian's core, the "Inner Sanctum." There
appears Dark Brain, Roar's old foe and Duminuss's own creator...

0x002D70.en:
Kouta and the others challenge the dark wisdom that seeks to wipe out
all intelligent life. In the deadly struggle, Dark Brain is destroyed
and the threat to Earth seemed to be removed...

0x002E96.en:
But Masaki's fear became real, and Shu Shirakawa at last bared his
fangs. After a bitter fight, Masaki and the others won, and Shu
accepted his fate and vanished into the rift between dimensions.

0x002FC2.en:
At last the battle came to an end.
As many people's feelings crossed, Folka, who succeeded the Shura
King, set off with Sordian for a new world...
